methods.frame-cache: Requested frame payload cache under shared byte budget
methods.element-cache: Cache only the requested frame element records
methods.selective-decode: Physical row selection through Parquet column readers
methods.element-lookup: Resident SQLite selection metadata, then hydrate complete records
methods.snapshot: One SQLite read transaction across a response; separate revocation epoch
methods.snapshot-admission: Short gate lifetime and one final admission, with spare pool capacity
methods.read-lock: HTTP readers share a lock; add and tag writes wait for exclusive lock

limitations: Opt-in benchmark prototypes; not enabled in normal application builds.
Only runs with sealing_startup_handshake=true enable background Parquet publication. Earlier matrices measure durable staging writes.
SQLite read reference is the first experiment binary with all methods disabled; final write/mixed pairs share their binary.
Single-pass shared workstation measurements, OS caches not flushed, 32-frame working set.
No hundreds-of-gigabytes, long-duration native capture, deferred extraction, or concurrent privacy/backup qualification.

Earlier candidate runs exposed ordinary OCR revocation conflicts and a reproducible stale FTS integrity-check connection. The failed fixtures are preserved; full-final uses the corrected trigger and dedicated startup verification connection.
